steps.label: Test and Debug
steps.content:
Year 6 Scratch

Test and Debug

Year 6, 6.2.6

  • Test a program like a tester: expected against actual.
  • Find and fix bugs in six broken Scratch projects.
  • Record a bug clearly enough for someone else to fix it.

steps.label: Test It Like a Tester
steps.content:
Test It Like a Tester

A bug is where what should happen and what does happen are different.

I didExpectedActual
Pressed left arrowRocket moves leftIt moved right
Clicked 10 timesSays You win!Said nothing
Clicked 9 timesNo message yetNo message
  • Test every control, one at a time.
  • Test the edges: the sides of the stage, the floor.
  • Test either side of a target: 9, 10 and 11 clicks.
  • Change one thing, then test again.

steps.label: Check: Testing
steps.content:
Check: Testing

Choose the best answer.

items.prompt: A game should say You win! at 10 clicks. Which click counts should you test?
items.explain: Test just below, on, and just above the target. Off-by-one bugs hide there.

items.prompt: Expected: the Rocket moves left. Actual: it moves right. What is this?
items.explain: Expected and actual are different, so there is a bug to fix.

steps.label: Activity 1: Bug Hunt 1 to 3
steps.content:
Activity 1: Bug Hunt 1 to 3

Work on your own. Each project has one bug. Test it, find the bug, fix it, then press Next.

Build it

  • Bug Hunt 1: one arrow key goes the wrong way.
  • Bug Hunt 2: a counter that gets stuck.
  • Bug Hunt 3: a ball that moves once and stops.
  • Test first: watch what happens before you change any blocks.

The panel beside TurboWarp lists the checks. Press Check my project as often as you like: it plays your game and tells you what it saw.

steps.label: Where Bugs Hide
steps.content:
Where Bugs Hide

What you see tells you where to look.

Goes the wrong wayLook at the numbers in the move and change blocks. Is one negative when it should be positive?
Happens once, then stopsBlocks that should keep running need to be inside a forever or repeat loop.
A value never resetsFind the green flag script. Does it set the variable?
Something never happensRead the condition. Which sprite or colour does it check? Is the comparison right?

steps.label: Check: Spot the Bug
steps.content:
Check: Spot the Bug

This script should move the sprite left.

when [left arrow v] key pressed
change x by (10)
Total: 1 mark

steps.label: Activity 2: Bug Hunt 4 to 6
steps.content:
Activity 2: Bug Hunt 4 to 6

Work on your own. The button opens Bug Hunt 4. Press Next after each fix.

Build it

  • Bug Hunt 4: coins that do not count.
  • Bug Hunt 5: a game you cannot win.
  • Bug Hunt 6: a game that never ends.
  • Then test a partner's game from last lesson.

The panel beside TurboWarp lists the checks. Press Check my project as often as you like: it plays your game and tells you what it saw.

steps.label: Test a Partner's Game
steps.content:
Test a Partner's Game

Swap with a partner and play their game from 6.2.5. Record one bug.

items.prompt: What did you do, what did you expect, and what actually happened? Which script do you think causes it?
items.modelAnswer: The exact action (pressed the up arrow at the top edge), what should happen (the ship stops at the edge), what did happen (it went off the stage), and a script to look at (the up arrow script has no edge check). One mark each for the action, expected against actual, and the script.

steps.label: Checked Practice
steps.content:
Checked Practice

Use what you found in the Bug Hunts.

items.prompt: score should go up by 1 per coin, but it jumps by 3 every time. Where do you look first?
items.explain: The script that changes score is the one that runs too many times: often because the Coin stays touching and nothing moves it away.

items.prompt: A game should end when lives reaches 0, but it never ends. Which condition has a bug?
items.explain: lives stops at 0, so "less than 0" is never true. It should be "= 0".

steps.label: Plenary: Test and Debug
steps.content:
Plenary: Test and Debug

Answer a batch of five. Three right in a row masters a card, and your progress is saved for your teacher.
